mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_version(id,kind,name,version,ref_id,artifact_uri,eval_result,status,approved_by,activated_at,created_at) VALUES(#{id},#{kind},#{name},#{version},#{refId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{artifactUri,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{evalResult,javaType=com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode,jdbcType=OTHER},#{status},NULL,NULL,#{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (kind,name,version) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM model_version WHERE kind=#{kind} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM model_version WHERE kind=#{kind}
SELECT * FROM model_version WHERE status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY kind,name
SELECT * FROM model_version WHERE kind=#{kind} AND name=#{name} AND status='ACTIVE'
SELECT COALESCE(max((eval_result->>'revision')::bigint),0)+1 FROM model_version WHERE kind=#{kind} AND name=#{name}
